title: Spellforge Flyer
description: A vibrant surreal scene shows a green turtle wearing a wizard hat and a blue dragon pulling a red wagon labeled "SPELLFORGE FLYER" across a cracked stone courtyard. The wagon is filled with books, potion bottles, and a small tree, while a swirling pink and purple vortex with lightning and floating pages dominates the dramatic sky.
prompt: A blue dragon with large wings pulls a red wagon labeled SPELLFORGE FLYER across a cracked stone courtyard. Inside the wagon a green turtle wearing a wizard hat and glasses sits among books, potion bottles and a small tree with purple leaves. A massive swirling pink and purple magical vortex with lightning bolts and floating pages fills the sky, dramatic orange sunset light, scattered stone monuments with dragon carvings, open books and spilled potions on the ground, vibrant fantasy illustration style
